_note: Every tuned number in the engine, defined ONCE. See core/constants.js for the semantics: structural = invariants (no dial, variants can never touch them); tunables = { value } or { range: [at0, at1], dial, gamma? } resolved from variants.json. Keys starting with _ are skipped.

physics._note: eps^2 of the softened gravity law — ONE law shared by stepGravity, orbitalSpeed and surfaceGravity (the AGENTS.md invariant, now one number).

atom._note: top of the atom grid ladder (10n^2+2 = 412,092 cells ≈ a Jupiter).

lod._note: switch: sample the render LOD once the camera exceeds this multiple of the body radius. asyncMinCells: geometry chains at or above this cell count build in the Web Worker (sync build would jank the frame).

server._note: previewFrequency: the skeleton's stub sample grid — also the floor for generated-body grids. fullInlineCells: bodies at or below this cell count ship complete in the skeleton; larger ones are stubs whose atoms stream on intent.
